title: Focused implementation review
statement: As a reviewer, I can expand one named implementation deck in the Report Saga sidebar, scan its sectioned slide thumbnails, and inspect the exact code behind each explanation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A report can expose several optional decks without rendering user stories or ordinary report fragments as slides; each authored deck is one sidebar disclosure.
Only semantic Items own exact diff evidence, including contextual surprise callouts.

Expanding one deck renders all of its slide thumbnails under that single deck node, optional section labels appear only as subtle dividers, selecting a slide gives it the full main review area, and navigation remains within the deck.
